questions.question: Does the rendered Introduction page use the same header/sidebar/reading-column/outline composition at desktop, and what actually happens at 390px?
questions.stopCondition: Both viewports reach the page end, restore to top, and page-scoped claims bind screenshot regions to non-zero DOM boxes and exact computed properties.

questions.question: Does the Button reference preserve the documentation shell while presenting live examples in a preview/code structure?
requiredEvidence: continuous scroll to API and theme variables
main DOM box and computed width
questions.stopCondition: The long page reaches its true end and its structural claim is traceable to a visible capture and DOM.

questions.question: Which visible hierarchy, density and supporting surfaces organize the Introduction content?
requiredEvidence: exact computed font sizes and weights
questions.stopCondition: The claim identifies the rendered title and supporting hierarchy without inferring a brand font from filenames or CSS variable names.

questions.question: Where are #5854FF and #7C66FF visibly used, and is orange a core action/accent on the frozen pages?
requiredEvidence: current-page navigation screenshot and computed color
Primary Button screenshot and computed fill
questions.stopCondition: Purple candidates are scoped to observed roles and orange remains out-of-scope unless a high-salience rendered region proves it.

questions.question: What visibly and computationally changes between Primary Button default, hover transition, hover settled, focus and activated-settled states?
questions.stopCondition: Every required state is captured; unchanged states are explicitly reported as no-change rather than assigned an invented highlight.
